description.text: The foil Mega Charizard X ex of one of the two Mega Charizard Tins of 20 February 2026, with four booster packs and a code card; the other tin held Mega Charizard Y ex 030. The print, with takuyoa's art, was first a Traditional Chinese promo in Taiwan and Hong Kong, in the Inferno X Value Set. The Mega Charizard X ex promo of the Ultra-Premium Collection is another card, Saboteri's 023.

One of nine illustration rare–style promos in the First Partner Illustration Collection—Series 1, launched 20 March 2026. Each collection held a pack of three of the nine, the first partners of Kanto, Sinnoh and Alola, with two more booster packs and a sticker sheet. Side by side, this card and the Charmander and Squirtle promos make one long picture of Kanto.

description.text: Paradise Resort was the promo card of the 2026 Pokémon World Championships in San Francisco, held from 28 to 30 August 2026 and the first Worlds split across two venues, the Moscone Center for the main event and the Chase Center for Championship Sunday. Naoki Saito's art features Gimmighoul, Psyduck, Sudowoodo, Klawf, Fidough, Charjabug, Spheal, Archaludon and Sylveon; it was revealed in June 2026 along with the competitors' welcome kits. Competitors received the card, staff got a Staff copy, and the top finishers got copies stamped with their placement.

The foil promo in one of the two 30th Celebration Tech Sticker Collections, launched 16 September 2026, where it stands for Pokémon Day Out, with a matching tech sticker sheet and three 30th Celebration boosters. The other held Lucario, for Pokémon Night Out. In mainland China the same art was the prize of the Alola Celebration team events.
